The primary source's Appendix H treats voter welfare, which is a different performance criterion. Relevant published-finding corpus semantic searches and published scientific results found no equivalent, though historical-priority uncertainty remains.

value.rationale: A uniformly enforceable lower candidate-quality floor is natural in shortlist reliability and project feasibility. The exact best fair-quality retention changes from a flat 3/4 to a sharp quadratic law above floor 1/2, for four independently meaningful reciprocal proportionality axioms. Matching asymptotic constructions make the improvement quantitatively tight and distinguish it from the prior universal bound.
